name: RL LP incentive airdrop reward miscalculation
summary: RLLpIncentive's airDropReward(address) pays out from the caller's current LP balance rather than a recorded stake, so the attacker shuttled the same LP position through many freshly created claimer contracts and collected the reward repeatedly.

loss.notes: Migrated from legacy lossUsd/lossOther. The legacy corpus did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.

limitations: Target identity and code history came from the v1 snapshot row originally at protocols/rl-token.json; no semantic revalidation was inherited.
